title: UAE firm to invest in aluminium project in Odisha
summary: A UAE-based company, International Holding Company, and the Adani Group are set to invest in an aluminium project in Odisha. The investment is expected to be worth $11.5 billion. The project is part of a larger initiative to boost India's aluminium production. The move is seen as a significant step towards diversifying India's economy.
summary_points: A UAE-based company and the Adani Group are investing in an aluminium project in Odisha.
The investment is expected to be worth $11.5 billion.
The project aims to boost India's aluminium production.
This move is seen as a step towards diversifying India's economy.
The project will likely have a significant impact on India's industrial sector.
